title: Connect newsletter signups to an email service
description: No signup backend exists. Choose a provider (or a Papyrus endpoint), set `newsletter.signupEndpoint` in `web/site-config.json`; the forms then POST `{email, lists, topics, page}` as JSON and show the success state and toast. Needs double opt-in, the precedential-alerts list, and a privacy policy page (the design links one).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Blocked on Papyrus initiative PPY-31455f (Outbound newsletters), milestone M1 PPY-08dbd8: SES per site, double opt-in signup endpoint, subscriber records, one-click unsubscribe. Papyrus builds it; this site then sets newsletter.signupEndpoint.
